title: ALIS: code and artifacts for "ALIS: Adaptive Selection of LLM Knowledge Interfaces for User Modeling in Recommender Systems"
description: Code, generated LLM user profiles with claim-level support scores, LLM-judge audit labels, logs, cost traces and result tables for the article ALIS: Adaptive Selection of LLM Knowledge Interfaces for User Modeling in Recommender Systems (User Modeling and User-Adapted Interaction, 2026). Experiments use MovieLens-1M, the Amazon review data (Books) and the Yelp Open Dataset; raw user histories are not redistributed. Code is MIT-licensed; generated artifacts and results are CC BY 4.0.
